name: Chenille Yarn Embroidery Corduroy Pillow Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from soft, durable ribbed corduroy fabric with a comfortable textured surface.
    - Features neat, tailored edges to help maintain a full and structured pillow shape.
    - Designed with an envelope closure for easy insert removal without a zipper.
    - Overlapping back panels help keep the pillow insert securely in place.
    - Available in Beige, Black, Light Pink, Navy, Grey, and Light Blue.
    📌 Note: Pillow insert is not included.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 6 sizes:
          +) 30 × 25 cm ~ 11.81 × 9.84 in
          +) 35 × 30 cm ~ 13.78 × 11.81 in
          +) 45 × 35 cm ~ 17.72 × 13.78 in
          +) 60 × 40 cm ~ 23.62 × 15.75 in
          +) 65 × 45 cm ~ 25.59 × 17.72 in
          +) 70 × 50 cm ~ 27.56 × 19.68 in
    - Embroidery area:
          +) 18 × 18 cm ~ 7.09 × 7.09 in for the 30 × 25 cm size.
          +) Up to 20 × 20 cm ~ 7.87 × 7.87 in for the other sizes.
     
  • Embroidery Technology:
    - Uses soft chenille yarn to create a thick, raised embroidery effect.

 

  •  Design File/Embroidery Notes:
    📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
    - Two yarn sizes are available: 2 cm chenille yarn and 7 mm chenille yarn.
    - Designs with up to 5 characters can use either yarn size.
    - Designs with up to 7 characters are suitable for 7 mm chenille yarn only.
    - Best suited for text, initials, simple characters, and clean-line fonts.
    - Complex artwork, detailed icons, and overly decorative text are not recommended.
    - Embroidery colors must be selected from the provided yarn color chart.
    - Actual colors may vary slightly due to lighting, screen settings, and differences between material batches.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    To keep your chenille embroidery looking soft, fluffy, and like new:
    - Wash the garment inside out in cold water using a gentle cycle.
    - Hang dry or tumble dry on low heat.
    - Do not iron directly on the chenille embroidery, as high heat may damage or melt the fibers. 
    - For best results, iron the garment inside out.
    - Do not soak or use bleach.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Adds personalized texture and dimension to sofas, beds, chairs, and benches.
    - Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, guest rooms, and offices.
    - Envelope closure allows easy insertion and removal of the pillow insert.
    - Works well for names, initials, short words, and simple decorative designs.
    - Ideal for everyday décor, seasonal styling, and personalized room accents.
    - Easy to coordinate with blankets, bedding, and other decorative pillows.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for birthdays, housewarmings, weddings, and anniversaries.
    - Great for Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and seasonal celebrations.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s Day, and baby showers.
    - Suitable for personalized family gifts, nursery décor, pet gifts, and memorial keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Chenille Yarn Embroidery Corduroy Pillow Case

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
